source.author: verg
source.text: Scio me Danais e classibus unum, et bello Iliacos fateor petiisse Penatis; pro quo, si sceleris tanta est iniuria nostri, spargite me in fluctus, vastoque immergite ponto.
source.text_original: Scio me Danais e classibus unum, / et bello Iliacos fateor petiisse Penatis; / pro quo, si sceleris tanta est iniuria nostri, / spargite me in fluctus, vastoque immergite ponto.
source.text_english: I know that I, one man from the Greek fleets, and in war, I confess, have sought out the household gods of Ilium; for this, if the wrong of my crime is so great, cast me into the waves and plunge me into the vast sea.

reuse.text: scio me cunctis e gentibus unum illicitas temptare vias hiememque mereri:
reuse.text_original: scio me cunctis e gentibus unum / illicitas temptare vias hiememque mereri: /
reuse.text_english: I know that I alone among all peoples try forbidden paths and deserve winter:
